response_difference.scope: Preserved unequal visible-output pair, not an equal-work K4V speed comparison. No numerical/API requirement changed. This numeric first-divergence audit does not establish the GPU/kernel cause or answer quality.

scope: One natural full completion per branch/mode/prompt at its independently maximum-fit arena, not repeated-trial statistics/equal-memory latency or long native-equivalence proof. Source-specific counters unavailable on main are null. Unequal responses remain reported but do not receive matched-work code/enablement gain claims. Nine different tasks across context bands do not isolate context scaling.
publication_note: Measurements and timing values are copied unchanged. The CSV measurement column and JSON receipt paths are repository-relative references to preserved local benchmark outputs; raw prompts/reports/binaries are not bundled. Missing main prediction-forward counters are null, not zero. Documentation edits after completion do not relabel the measured source or binaries.
